She recovers $20,000 plus interest and attorney's fees, less the $600 in dividends

explanation: Under USA §410, a buyer in an unlawful sale may sue to recover the consideration paid plus interest at the legal rate and reasonable attorney's fees, less any income received, upon tendering the security. distractorExplanations.a: The USA limitation period runs years from the sale and from discovery, not one year from the sale, so this suit is timely.
distractorExplanations.b: Treble damages belong to other laws, such as federal insider-trading penalties; USA §410 restores the price plus interest and fees.
distractorExplanations.c: Income received on the security, such as these dividends, is deducted from the recovery so the buyer is not paid twice.
